targets.expr:
sum by (reason, source) (
  label_replace(rate(api_eve_token_login_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "eve_token_login", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_session_refresh_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "session_refresh", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_eve_sso_code_exchange_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "eve_sso_code_exchange", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_eve_sso_token_refresh_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "eve_sso_token_refresh", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_jobs_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "jobs", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_groups_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "groups", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_archived_jobs_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "archived_jobs", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_system_indexes_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "system_indexes", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_market_prices_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "market_prices", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_static_data_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "static_data", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_app_config_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "app_config", "reason", ".*")
  or label_replace(rate(api_cloud_stored_esi_refresh_tokens_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "additional_character_refresh_tokens", "reason", ".*")
) $err_source

options.value: * on(source) group_left() (max by (source) (label_replace(rate(api_eve_sso_code_exchange_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "eve_sso_code_exchange", "reason", ".*") * 0 + 1) or max by (source) (label_replace(rate(api_eve_sso_token_refresh_errors_total[$__rate_interval]), "source", "eve_sso_token_refresh", "reason", ".*") * 0 + 1))
